character.name: The Tile-Hoarder of Dodge Hollow

traits.title: Built from ten thousand tiles
traits.description: Roughly two-thirds of its body is made of .json pieces, so it stitches itself together one data file at a time.

traits.title: Wears its headers like armour
traits.description: Its heart is src/game.h, a header that pulls in array, chrono, cstdint, ctime and functional before it does anything else.

traits.title: Keeps its mods in one big chest
traits.description: Nearly half its parts live in data/mods/, so every new wasteland creature gets stored in the same drawer.

character.originStory: Long ago, in a valley where the sky never quite stopped flickering, a tinkerer tried to build a survivor out of scraps. The scraps were ideas: a world that stays put between sessions, a vehicle with a full tank of gas, a horde of giant insects and killer robots. Nothing could hold them together until the tinkerer wrote a single header, game.h, and bound it with clanking chains of includes. Each night the creature grew another piece from the mods folder, a zombie here, a rusty dish there, until it stood up on its own. Now it wanders the wasteland with a glowing stare and a top hat, still scavenging for parts. Travellers say that if you listen closely near its chains, you can hear it humming C++ to itself, counting every tile it has ever collected.
